card.name: Words just before 'certified' in REMS rules
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected 'certified' or 'certification' in REMS program rules, such as 'specially' or 'must be' after pharmacies. Weaker hits appear on other words in certification and licensing text.

modes.label: Before 'certified'
modes.description: Adverb or verb that leads into 'certified' for prescribers or pharmacies in a REMS.
modes.example: Healthcare Providers who prescribe XYWAV are<< specially>> certified

modes.label: Pharmacy must be certified
modes.description: Modal verbs after 'Pharmacies' that lead into being certified in the program.
modes.example: Pharmacies must<< be>> certified in the REMS and must only

modes.label: Education or licensing wording
modes.description: Words in training, accreditation or licensing text where a certification term is likely next.
modes.example: or another education<< program>> that includes all the elements of the FDA
